world_fit_review.pattern_specific_checks: Anthropomorphic cast pass: oversized round head with reddish-brown shaggy color blocks framing a broad bare grey-brown ape face, flat nostrils, cream oval eyes and smile, short torso, exactly two relaxed longer arms/hands and two short standing feet. No tail, whiskers, cat nose, giant adult cheek disks, branches or props. Juvenile-inspired orangutan representation assigned to requested Bornean species; coat alone is not claimed as a diagnostic separation from Sumatran species. Native light/dark views show clean contour/paper texture, intact hands/feet and no extra appendages.
world_fit_review.basis: Actual selected native source and light/dark composites assessed after the user specified two patterns; prior natural-pose technical QA is not reused as current adoption permission.

geometry.anchor_measurement: manually observed anatomical support/centre in the native full-body image; not alpha-canvas centering
geometry.anchor_basis: Midpoint of the two broad standing ape foot contacts beneath upright torso; two longer forelimbs terminate in the visible hands, not additional support legs.
geometry.vertical_motion_policy: neutral still; scene placement and any trajectory are designed by consumer, no motion acceptance claimed

resolution_review.review_basis: Native light/dark composites visually inspected; species/face/contour remain readable. This is a static asset display limit, not a completed-video acceptance.

alpha_policy: Original RGBA bytes retained, alpha254 and imperceptible <8 isolated fringes are not erased; visible light/dark composites govern image-quality decision.
scope: One independent neutral original inspected at native resolution and on light/dark backgrounds. No poses, interpolation, runtime or completed-video acceptance claimed.
